title: Life Stage Classifier
description:
Read a birth year and the current year from input. Calculate the person's age. Print their age and classify them into a life stage: `Child` (0–12), `Teenager` (13–17), `Young Adult` (18–35), `Middle-Aged` (36–60), `Senior` (61+). Also print how many years until they turn 65 (or `Already 65 or older` if applicable).

**Example (inputs: `1990`, `2025`):**
```
Age: 35
Life stage: Young Adult
Years until 65: 30
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
birth_year = int(input())
current_year = int(input())
expectedOutput:
Age: 35
Life stage: Young Adult
Years until 65: 30
hint: age = current_year - birth_year. Use if/elif for life stage. For years until 65, max(0, 65 - age).
